description.en: High-resolution fashion portraits that preserve identity and reproduce the uploaded garment faithfully.
description.zh: 只保留人物身份与上传衣服，生成高清、有质感的写实换装图片和视频。

description.en: Premium full-body studio portrait focused on garment silhouette, construction and fabric texture.
description.zh: 全身高清棚拍，突出衣服版型、剪裁、材质和上身质感。

useWhen.en: Use for clean, premium garment presentation and product-detail inspection.
useWhen.zh: 适合清晰展示衣服整体版型与面料细节。

en: Keep the full body visible and make the transferred garment the visual focus.
Use premium soft studio lighting and realistic fabric micro-texture.
zh: 保持全身完整，上传衣服是唯一视觉重点。
使用高级柔光并保留真实面料微纹理。

en: Avoid accessories or styling that hide the garment.
Avoid plastic skin, invented garment details and identity drift.
zh: 避免塑料皮肤、虚构衣服细节和人物漂移。

description.en: Natural full-body fashion portrait in a believable contemporary Asian everyday environment.
description.zh: 在真实的亚洲当代日常环境中，生成自然、高清、有生活质感的全身换装照。

useWhen.en: Use for believable lifestyle fashion imagery and the 18-second daily-life video route.
useWhen.zh: 适合生活化穿搭图片以及 18 秒日常场景视频。

en: Use a contemporary Asian daily-life environment with natural movement.
Keep the garment fully readable with realistic daylight and restrained depth of field.
zh: 使用真实的亚洲当代日常环境与自然动作。
使用自然光和克制景深，确保衣服完整清晰。

en: Avoid tourist landmarks, fantasy scenery and unrelated props.
Avoid excessive blur, dramatic effects and garment occlusion.
zh: 避免旅游地标、奇幻环境和无关道具。
避免过度虚化、戏剧特效和衣服遮挡。
